validated.scope: The28 comparison runs only; additional visible Chrome and IAB checks are reported separately.

fixed_conditions.video: Original1x native browser playback of the explicitly provided H264 day/night fixtures; no seek/loop/repeat, no response mock
fixed_conditions.model: Same selected checkpoint within every comparison; original80-class default, optional87-class independently tested
fixed_conditions.compute: FP32, native detection Graph, depth edge768, fixed TensorRT FP32 artifacts when selected; no INT8/FP16 or threshold changes
fixed_conditions.input: Max640/JPEG80/30FPS admission ceiling; source timestamps and skip counts retained; no submitted frames discarded on EOF
fixed_conditions.speech: Local Microsoft Huihui Chinese voice, rate2, production Guidance policy and native synthesis events; no fabricated risk
fixed_conditions.timing: All warm EOF frames retained; first frame separated; cold startup and manual-stop sessions reported independently. Capture-to-decode is not physical screen paint. Source input subsets differ with real playback and backpressure
fixed_conditions.host_variation: Uncontrolled Windows scheduling/thermal/clock drift; bracketing controls retained; results are observed local measurements, not confidence intervals or universal guarantees

decision.backend: Keep explicitly selected TensorRT+host fusion for this local demo; all original defaults remain available
decision.admission: Add an opt-in low-latency3-job mode to the local-video page; original12-job default preserved. It changes source admission/coverage and may trade throughput for latency; it is not a new model Forward gain
decision.limits: Only the independent local-video selector is changed; camera and unified pages retain original defaults
decision.speech_gate_scope: Only observed risk utterances that actually started; unstarted cancellations and interrupted speech are separately retained. Engine start does not prove audibility or alert accuracy

initial_failures.actions: Separate cold EOF from manual-stop test; confirm actual GPU release with bounded read-only health observations before opening a new session; no automatic inference retries

reproduction.backend_order: Per model: Torch/GPU before, TensorRT/GPU, TensorRT/host, Torch/GPU after; both day/night per profile, fresh owned service per profile
reproduction.queue_order: One fixed TensorRT/host service per model; per video12-before,3,12-after; three independent browser sessions per report
reproduction.cli: node ../frontend/tools/check_local_video_browser.mjs http://127.0.0.1:8766/integration/video/ NEW.json VIDEO.mp4 --pending-limit 3|12; add --headed for visible Chrome
reproduction.sample_preservation: Every frame, source PTS, timing, skipped-source counter and failure retained. No statistical outlier removal or relaxed gate.

backend.initial_regression: tests-final.log retained: explicit-path validation was incorrectly applied to already validated default-path test seams; restricted to the new explicit option. Ruff docstring line-width failure is retained in ruff-verified.log.

checks.manual_documentation_review: Reviewed all changed file responsibility/module/declaration/variable indexes, method documentation and explicit default/configuration boundaries. No tools/check_docs.py exists.
checks.log_formatting: Trailing blank lines and trailing coverage-table spaces are normalized for Git only; all measurement values and failures remain.
